{{Short description|Norwegian physicist (born 1970)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2025}}[[File:Maria Strømme (50266843491).jpg|thumb|Maria Strømme in August 2020]]
'''Maria Strømme''' (born 7 April 1970 in [[Svolvær]]) is a Norwegian physicist who lives and works in [[Sweden]].

== Career ==
She became a professor in [[nanotechnology]] at [[Uppsala University]] in 2004.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uu.se/forskning/forskarprofilen-maria-stromme/ |title=Forskarprofilen Maria Strömme - Uppsala universitet |publisher=uu.se |accessdate=3 October 2015 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151001131455/http://www.uu.se/forskning/forskarprofilen-maria-stromme/ |archivedate=1 October 2015 }}</ref> She became Sweden's youngest professor in a technical subject.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nyteknik.se/nyheter/innovation/forskning_utveckling/article3918753.ece|title=Professorn brinner för nanoteknikens möjligheter|work=NyTeknik|accessdate=3 October 2015|archive-date=8 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150908192414/http://www.nyteknik.se/nyheter/innovation/forskning_utveckling/article3918753.ece|url-status=dead}}</ref> Strømme holds a master of science degree in engineering physics, and completed her doctoral thesis in solid state physics in 1997 at [[Uppsala University]].<ref>Maria Strømme, Cation intercalation and surface fractality in metal oxide based films, Comprehensive summaries of Uppsala dissertations from the Faculty of Science and Technology, 1104-232X; 252, 1997.</ref> She became a scientist at Naturvetenskapliga forskningsrådet. Between 2002 and 2007, she worked as an academy physicist and she was elected to the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]]. She is also a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]], the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ntva.no/medlemmer/|title=Medlemmer|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|accessdate=2020-04-06}}</ref> and the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://dnva.no/medlemmer/53|title=Utenlandske medlemmer|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=no|access-date=27 December 2021}}</ref>

== Retracted AIP Advances article ==
In 2025, Strømme published the paper "Universal consciousness as foundational field: A theoretical bridge between quantum physics and non-dual philosophy" in ''AIP Advances''. The paper was retracted in 2026 by AIP Publishing and the editors due to concerns about its scientific validity, noting that a central operator in the theory had no associated measurable quantity and that the theory's predictions could not be empirically verified or falsified.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Strømme |first=Maria |date=2026-05-07 |title=Retraction: "Universal consciousness as foundational field: A theoretical bridge between quantum physics and non-dual philosophy" [AIP Adv. 15(11), 115319 (2025)] |journal=AIP Advances |language=en |volume=16 |issue=5 |pages=059902 |doi=10.1063/5.0339733 |issn=2158-3226 |url=https://pubs.aip.org/aip/adv/article/16/5/059902/3388991/Retraction-Universal-consciousness-as-foundational|doi-access=free }}</ref>
